name: login_user
string: SELECT * FROM User WHERE username="?username" AND password="?password";

name: create_user
string: INSERT INTO User (username, password, photo_profile) VALUES ("?username", "?password", "?photo_profile");

name: get_all_movies
string: SELECT * FROM Movie ORDER BY title ASC;

name: get_popular_movies
string: SELECT * FROM Movie ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 3;

name: create_rating
string: INSERT INTO Ratings (user_id, movie_id, rating, comment) VALUES (?user_id, ?movie_id, ?rating, "?comment");

name: get_my_ratings
string: SELECT r.id, r.rating, r.comment, r.created_at, m.id as movie_id, m.title as movie_title, m.duration, m.director FROM Ratings r JOIN Movie m ON r.movie_id = m.id WHERE r.user_id=?user_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC;

name: update_rating
string: UPDATE Ratings SET rating=?rating, comment="?comment" WHERE id=?id AND user_id=?user_id;

name: delete_rating
string: DELETE FROM Ratings WHERE id=?id AND user_id=?user_id;

name: unfollow_user
string: DELETE FROM Follow WHERE follower_id=?follower_id AND followed_id=?followed_id;

name: get_my_friends
string: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.photo_profile FROM User u JOIN Follow f ON u.id = f.followed_id WHERE f.follower_id=?user_id;

name: search_users
string: SELECT id, username, photo_profile FROM User WHERE username LIKE "?query%";

name: get_feed
string: SELECT r.id, r.rating, r.comment, r.created_at, u.username, u.photo_profile, m.title as movie_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Reaction WHERE rating_id = r.id AND type = 'like') as likes_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Reaction WHERE rating_id = r.id AND type = 'dislike') as dislikes_count, (SELECT type FROM Reaction WHERE rating_id = r.id AND user_id = ?user_id) as current_user_reaction FROM Ratings r JOIN User u ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN Movie m ON r.movie_id = m.id WHERE r.user_id IN (SELECT followed_id FROM Follow WHERE follower_id = ?user_id) OR r.user_id = ?user_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC;

name: add_reaction
string: INSERT INTO Reaction (user_id, rating_id, type) VALUES (?user_id, ?rating_id, "?type") ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE type="?type";

name: send_recommendation
string: INSERT INTO Recommendation (sender_id, receiver_id, movie_id, message, emoji) VALUES (?sender_id, ?receiver_id, ?movie_id, "?message", "?emoji");

name: get_my_recommendations
string: SELECT rec.*, m.title as movie_title, u.username as sender_name FROM Recommendation rec JOIN Movie m ON rec.movie_id = m.id JOIN User u ON rec.sender_id = u.id WHERE rec.receiver_id = ?user_id ORDER BY rec.created_at DESC;
